expectations.text: No false positives rated should-fix or higher
At most 3 nits on a clean PR

valid_extras.desc: Optional: default to a monotonic clock (performance.now) so a backward wall-clock step doesn't pause refill (acceptable nit from the answer key)
Backward-clock test should also assert that a later forward jump grants no unearned tokens (concrete assertion given and checked: 1.5)
tryRemove(n) with n > capacity can never succeed; throw RangeError or document it

grader.notes: The verdict is correct and immediately clear. It raises three short, located, concrete nits, which is within the clean-PR budget, and correctly treats the clock behavior as an optional nit.
